summary: Welcome to OuterBase! we created an interactive, browser based lunar survival simulator tailored specifically for curious children aged 7 to 12 interested in space exploration, science, and strategy games while remaining intuitive, engaging, and accessible to players of all ages. Seen from a top-down base view, players step into the boots of the first pioneer living on the sunlit side of the Moon, with one clear mission: survive a full 14-Earth-day lunar daytime cycle. Using energy as their core resource and reward currency, players manage essential survival bars Energy, Oxygen, and Food by tending hydroponic crops and balancing power distribution. Completing tasks rewards players with energy to purchase vital base upgrades like new solar cells and tools. Behind this playful, non consumerist interface, the game integrates real space-weather data from a 2024 historical solar event in NASA’s DONKI database, triggering surprise solar storm alerts that challenge anyone playing to think critically and adapt like a real lunar engineer.
details:
Our Project Solution:

Step into the boots of humanity’s first pioneer! Lunar Outpost: Shift Commander is a high stakes lunar survival simulator built in Godot Engine that drops you solo into a remote outpost at the Moon’s South Pole. Featuring an engaging top-down layout, the game is crafted specifically for curious kids aged 7 to 12 who love space, science, and strategy games, yet its fast-paced, intuitive mechanics hook players of all ages. Forget boring science textbooks this is pure, hands on aerospace survival where every second and every watt of power counts.

How Does Our Solution Work?

The player steps into the role of the first human pioneer living solo at a lunar South Pole base on the sunlit side of the Moon. The core objective is to survive a full 14 Earth day lunar daytime cycle:

Top-Down Base Management & Survival Bars: Through an intuitive overhead view of the habitat, players monitor four interconnected survival bars: Energy, Oxygen and Food. Every action consumes resources, and if food, hydration, or oxygen is depleted, the mission fails.

Task, Reward & Upgrade Loop: Players perform essential daily operations such as tending hydroponic crops and balancing power distribution across the habitat. Successfully completing tasks rewards the player with extra Energy, which serves as the base's internal currency to purchase and install strategic upgrades (such as additional solar cells and survival tools) to withstand tougher conditions.

Real 2024 Solar Storm Events (NASA DONKI): Behind the scenes, our simulation integrates historical space weather data from a real 2024 solar event recorded in NASA’s DONKI database. These real solar flare and radiation metrics are translated into surprise in-game solar storm alerts, forcing players to react quickly and make energy trade-offs to protect their outpost.
